title: OpenAI Launches Decisions API at $0.10 Per Million Input Tokens
summary:
Developers can now implement near real-time classification and input evaluation for their AI agents without the computational overhead of generating a complete model response. OpenAI has moved its Decisions API from public beta to general availability to enable the construction of more cost-efficient application workflows.

The API is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.01 per million cached tokens. The tool is designed to let applications autonomously select the most appropriate model or action in near real-time and is up to 10x faster than using GPT-6 Luna via the Responses API.
